items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: Fletcher Henderson taught me those basic fundamentals, and he did it as an extra bonus payment for me for copying his music

ctx.x: Yes, as I said, Fletcher Henderson taught me those basic fundamentals, and he did it as an extra bonus payment for me for copying his music that he needed very badly and quickly. Because he was writing for Benny Goodman when he was playing in the Coconut Grove, Ambassador Hotel, and you know, many times they'd have to change the copyist arrangement around and he needed a quick copies, like, you know, that was able to do this.
